setupText:
The storefront shows local listings, not the full registry. Sell includes 1,252 Java Edition 26.2 item types. Local drafts, listing submission, search, sorting, favorites and advertising previews work.
Show sample cards enables clearly labeled demonstration offers.
Discord login, the shared database, deals, chat, ratings and secured administration are not connected.
Demo ads are stored in this browser only. Site-wide publishing requires server-side admin-role checks in Firebase.
rulesText:
1. This site cannot access inventories or deliver items.
2. All payments and exchanges happen manually on the server.
3. Agree on the item, quantity, price and meeting place first.
4. Never share passwords or login codes.
5. Confirm a deal only after the exchange.
6. Verification does not guarantee seller honesty.

exclusionsText:
Two exclusion types: items unavailable in ordinary Java 26.2 survival and groups hidden at your request. Hidden does not mean unobtainable.
Fence gates, fences, doors, trapdoors, buttons, pressure plates, iron chain, chests (including chest vehicles), walls and bars are hidden. Building slabs and chestplates remain available.
Full list with reasons: data/exclusions.json.

exclusionReasons.no_item_drop: does not drop as an item
exclusionReasons.no_silverfish_item_drop: infested blocks do not drop as items
exclusionReasons.owner_hidden_gates: fence gates hidden by catalog settings
exclusionReasons.owner_hidden_pressure_plates: pressure plates hidden by catalog settings
exclusionReasons.owner_hidden_iron_chain: iron chain hidden by catalog settings
exclusionReasons.owner_hidden_chests: chests and chest vehicles hidden by catalog settings
exclusionReasons.owner_hidden_walls: walls and bars hidden by catalog settings
